name: witness
description: Proves a change of an iOS app in the simulator with xcodebuild and xcrun simctl only: runs the tests, installs and launches the app, takes a screenshot and writes a dated report; compares a before and an after proof.

interface.shortDescription: Prove an iOS change in the simulator with Apple's tools only.
interface.longDescription: Runs the tests of an Xcode project on a named simulator, installs and launches the app, takes a screenshot and writes a dated report with the commit, the simulator, the test result and the measured durations. Refuses to run in a main checkout.
defaultPrompt: Prove this iOS change in the simulator.
